//consequence: Read this before adding an entry back. A metric that is not recorded here is not compared by `ratchet-measures.mjs` at all, and the Lighthouse floors themselves are `continue-on-error` while this file exists. Performance is therefore currently ungated in both directions. That is the mechanism's own design — a metric that reaches its floor never comes back to the ratchet — and it stops being a gap the moment this file is empty and deleted, which is the point of it.
